notes: The served counts match the source. Counts are participants with at least one adverse event, not total adverse events (24 in the S boulardii group and 12 in the placebo group). Safety was evaluated as-treated; ten participants who took no study drug were excluded. The randomized totals were 246 and 231, respectively, whereas the reported safety denominators are 245 and 222. The window quotes the general study follow-up; a separate adverse-event assessment window is not stated.
